text: Toronto and East York Community Council will introduce bills.

General Bills Toronto and East York Community Council passed By-laws 122-2025 to 137-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006. Confirmatory Bill Toronto and East York Community Council passed a Confirmatory Bill as By-law 138-2025, subject to Section 226.9 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006.
